message.content:
A vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a red and black color scheme. In the upper center, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, grey serif capital letters. Above it, white text reads "SIAPA TERSERET NYANYIAN SETYA / SAAT GOOGLE BERLABUH DI GO-JEK". Below "TEMPO" is smaller white text: "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU".

Centrally, a vertical neon sign with rounded corners glows with a purple-pink outline. Inside, orange neon letters spell "INVESTIGASI" above the larger words "SETELAH ALEXIS BERSALIN RUPA". To the lower right of the sign, smaller white block text begins with "GUBERNUR BOLEH BERGANTI...".

On the right side, a black silhouette of a person’s profile and upper body faces left. The figure holds a silhouette of a stemmed glass. At the bottom left, a white rectangular box contains a barcode, the number "00049", and "9 770126 427302". Beside it, small white text lists the date "29 JANUARI-4 FEBRUARI 2018", price "RP 45.000", and other details. The background shows dark red rectangular panels behind the neon sign.
